background_image_description: Four smiling young adults sit side-by-side behind a large blank white board, centered against a plain light wall. The image has soft natural light and a clean, minimal style, with mostly neutral clothing accented by a bright orange-and-blue striped sweater on the right.

nodes.asset_description: A bright, flash-lit photo shows four people gathered around a glossy white table, chatting and smiling while one person in a vivid blue sweater gestures across the table. The minimal setup—a white wall, a hint of plant, and a paper on the right—uses saturated blues, blacks, and whites for a casual meeting vibe.

nodes.svg_description: Off-white rectangular card with sharp corners covering the lower portion of the canvas; solid fill (#F7F7F7). Inside the card, a thin horizontal cobalt blue rule (#0A44FF) runs the full width about 24 px above the card’s bottom edge.
